**q22.** dispatcher — `APIV1Service.DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` → `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook`, `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:15,47` (called from `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:157`); delivery package — `internal/webhook` (`PostAsync` at `internal/webhook/webhook.go:184` queues onto a 4-worker goroutine pool, `Post` at :118 does the HTTP POST via an SSRF-guarded client); signing — Standard Webhooks HMAC-SHA256 over `msgID + "." + timestamp + "." + body`, emitted as `webhook-id` / `webhook-timestamp` / `webhook-signature: v1,<base64>` headers with a `whsec_`-prefixed base64 secret (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:130-146`).

**q25.** Engine: CEL (google/cel-go) wrapped by the in-repo `internal/filter` package — `internal/filter/engine.go` (`NewEngine`/`DefaultEngine` at :16/:111), schema in `internal/filter/schema.go`, IR in `internal/filter/ir.go`, SQL emission in `internal/filter/render.go`. Mechanism: the handler validates the filter (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_filter.go` / `shortcut_service.go:336`) and appends it to `FindMemo.Filters`; each dialect driver compiles it to a dialect-agnostic condition tree and renders it with its own `DialectName` — `filter.AppendConditions(ctx, engine, find.Filters, filter.DialectSQLite|DialectPostgres|DialectMySQL, &where, &args)` at `store/db/sqlite/memo.go:61`, `store/db/postgres/memo.go:58`, `store/db/mysql/memo.go:69` — producing dialect-specific SQL fragments plus bound args.

**q26.** `memo_relation`, `attachment`, `memo` (the memo row plus any comment memo rows and their relations/attachments). Reactions are read for the webhook payload but not deleted (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go:545-582`, `store/memo.go:140-158`).

**q27.** Mechanism: the built `dist/` bundle is compiled into the Go binary with `//go:embed dist/*` and served by Echo's `middleware.StaticWithConfig` plus an SPA fallback to `index.html`. File: `server/router/frontend/frontend.go:20-21,40-59` (wired from `server/server.go:70`).

**q28.**
```
s3presign runner (server/runner/s3presign/runner.go) — RunOnce at startup, then a time.Ticker every 12h (runner.go:27,29-41); started in server/server.go:148-166
```
Also (not "runners" but background goroutines): 4 webhook delivery workers started in `internal/webhook/webhook.go:42-54`'s `init()`, and the SSE hub's per-client goroutines (`server/router/api/v1/sse_hub.go`).

Unused infra note: `internal/scheduler` — a full cron scheduler (`internal/scheduler/scheduler.go`, `job.go`, `parser.go`, `middleware.go`) — is **not** used by the server; the only importers are its own tests (`internal/scheduler/example_test.go:10`, `integration_test.go:13`). `server/runner/memopayload` is a helper package (`RebuildMemoPayload`), not a scheduled runner.

**q29.** Interceptor: `authInterceptor` in `web/src/connect.ts:156-178` (installed on the Connect transport at :188). Tokens it manages: a short-lived JWT **access token** (kept in memory + `localStorage`, sent as `Authorization: Bearer …`; state in `web/src/auth-state.ts`) and a long-lived **refresh token** held in the httpOnly `memos_refresh` cookie (sent via `credentials: "include"`, exchanged through `AuthService.RefreshToken` on a separate no-interceptor transport, `connect.ts:65-91`). Backend validation package: `server/auth` (`server/auth/authenticator.go`, `token.go` — JWT access/refresh tokens plus Personal Access Tokens), invoked by `NewAuthorizer`/`NewAuthInterceptor` in `server/router/api/v1/authz.go` and `connect_interceptors.go`.

**q30.**
```
memo created:          DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook        — memo_service_webhooks.go:15 (from memo_service.go:157)
memo updated:          DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook        — memo_service_webhooks.go:20 (via dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects, memo_update_helpers.go:67; called from UpdateMemo memo_service.go:513, SetMemoRelations memo_relation_service.go:48, SetMemoAttachments memo_attachment_service.go:48)
memo deleted:          DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook        — memo_service_webhooks.go:25 (from memo_service.go:562)
memo comment created:  DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook — memo_service_webhooks.go:30 (from memo_service_comments.go:119)
```
The first three funnel through `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` (`server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go:47`); all four converge on `webhook.PostAsync` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:184`) → `webhook.Post` (`internal/webhook/webhook.go:118`) for delivery.
